segments.name: Academia & Government
segments.description: Connects trusted scholarly content, library software and AI research assistants to serve universities, academic libraries and government research institutions worldwide.
segments.evidence: Universities, funders, and organizations rely on our Web of Science product family to uncover, evaluate, and make evidence-based decisions using our citation network that underpins the research ecosystem.

segments.name: Intellectual Property
segments.description: Provides intellectual property data, software and expertise to companies, law firms and patent offices managing, protecting and renewing IP assets.
segments.evidence: Our IP management software elevates operational performance and simplifies the process of managing valuable patent and brand asset portfolios.

segments.name: Life Sciences & Healthcare
segments.description: Provides AI-powered intelligence platforms and therapeutic area data to pharmaceutical, medical device and biotech customers across the drug development lifecycle.
segments.evidence: Our LS&H segment empowers life sciences and healthcare organizations with the contextual intelligence needed to deliver safe, effective, and commercially successful treatments and solutions to patients faster.

revenueModel.text: Customers including academic institutions, corporations, law firms, governments and pharmaceutical companies pay mainly through subscriptions, re-occurring renewal services and transactional project fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide solutions to our customers primarily through subscription arrangements and re-occurring contracts, which provide us with stable revenues and predictable cash flows.

changes.text: In 2024 the company divested its ScholarOne and Valipat businesses.
changes.evidence: As part of our efforts, in 2024 we divested our ScholarOne and Valipat businesses.

changes.text: In 2025 the company began winding down certain product groups within the A&G and LS&H segments.
changes.evidence: Complete product group wind-downs started in 2025 within the A&G and LS&H segments, further transitioning from transactional sales to subscriptions.
